description:
Pre-close gate for bl-f1c5. After all phases merge, audit shipped shape against:
- ARCH §2.3 (branches, hyphenated descent, sibling worktrees).
- ARCH §2.5 (dispatch primitive, every-tool-returns-synchronously, handle-based async).
- ARCH §2.6 (merge protocol, alignment step, merge=ours discipline on goal/soul/summary).
- ARCH §3.3 (tool contract — dispatch + await as in-process built-ins; binary + schema + skill triple).
- ARCH §3.4 (CLI as control plane — lernie dispatch worker is a normal subcommand, not a back-channel).
- ARCH §11 (oversized auto-dispatch, if shipped, no longer in deferred list).
- PRINCIPLES.md (single source of truth — handle data is derivable from git refs, no sidecar tracking; one obvious path — dispatch is one primitive used uniformly).
- TAXONOMY.md (banned terms — no 'invocation' as structural term in code or comments; check 'handle' usage is consistent).

For each section, sample two implementation points and confirm they match. Flag any drift as a follow-up ball under this epic; do not silently close over divergence.
Close when audit notes posted and any drift balls filed.
title: Gate: alignment (v0.4 epic)
